judgement.reason: Focalboard supports PostgreSQL via config and file storage can be moved off local disk with a contained change, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is appropriate.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /opt/focalboard/data (docker/Dockerfile), volume fbdata:/opt/focalboard/data (docker/docker-compose.yml app)
reviews.reason: The image creates /opt/focalboard/data/files and declares it as a volume, and no shown setting moves uploaded files to S3, so the app likely needs durable local storage that Fargate containers do not keep.
